content: MK places the purge in the context of Shāhrukh's aggressive attempts to consolidate eastern and western Iran under his direct control, in which he targeted both messianic movements such as the Ḥurūfiyya and Nūrbakhshiyya and extra-establishment intellectuals like Ibn Turka and his circle as ungovernable threats to his tenuously centralized state, and of his efforts to control the religious scene under his Sunnizing project.
